Rockman & Forte - Mirai Kara no Chousens.name: Rockman & Forte: Mirai kara no Chousensha
Rockman & Forte - Mirai Kara no Chousens.summary: Rockman & Forte: Mirai kara no Chousensha is a video game in the classic Rockman series. It is considered to be a "sequel" to Rockman & Forte due to its naming, though it actually continues on from the story of Rockman World II.
